item.title: Word of the Day: Waggish
item.description: Phonetic: /WAG-ish/Part of Speech: adjective Definition Waggish describes someone who is silly and playful, and especially someone who displays a mischievous sense of humor. The word can also describe things that such a person might do or possess. He had a waggish disposition that could irk adults but typically delighted children.
